rubrics.text: as of a light current passing over the dorsum
sensation of a large body in nose
from least contact of cold air
flows into fauces and rattle while breathing
with soreness beneath nose and on margin of nose
leaving nostrils raw and bleeding until others form
but if pulled away too soon cause soreness at root and intolerance of light
seem to come from an ulcer
large must discharge through posterior nares
feels as if she had two noses
in nasal passage while walking in open air
as of a weight hanging down
child starts out of sleep and
liquids come out through nose on attempting to swallow
surrounded by red swelling like acne rosacea
from left to above left eye
at left wing with desire to rub
from root along orbital arch to external angle of left eye
as if air streamed in on coughing or talking
followed by dullness in back of head
as if brain were forcing its way out
pulling sensation in left side as if a hair were pulling
extending to occiput on blowing nose
extending to ear on blowing nose
extending to forehead on blowing nose
on blowing the nose as if bones rubbed together
extending to external angle of eye
sensitive to the odor of broth
with sensation of leaflet at root
lasting 4 to 6 hours with sinking of strength
on right lachrymal bone which throbs
seems to draw up the wing
